newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 25.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones industrial average jumped 53.29 points to 6,471.76. It was the Dow's 42nd record high for 1996 and the 11th this month. The index added 123.73 for the week.
* Indonesia gets $260 million from the World Bank to finance infrastucture projects in Sulawesi and improve railway networks in Java.

* The Jakarta Composite Index rose 9.87 points, or 1.64 percent to close at 612.86 points on Friday ahead of the listing of giant Bank Negara Indonesia on the back of bargain-hunting and fresh buying in some big-caps, brokers said.
* Brokers said the market was likely to be higher on Monday, with some fresh offshore funds coming into the market which should be boosted by the listing of Bank Negara Indonesia.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,345.75/46.25 at 0200 GMT against the opening of 2,343.50/44.50.
* Property firm Putra Surya Perkasa on reports that its apartment complex in Jakarta had booked sales of 50 billion rupiah during the launch.
* Timber firm Barito Pacific on market talk of a possible takeover by a prominent business group despite a company denial on Friday.
* Banking stocks on a possible spillover effect of the listing of Bank Negara Indonesia.
* PT London Sumatra on reports that it will soon open a 26,000 hectares oil palm plantation in South Sumatra.
